integrity: Self-contained mathematical proof and reproducible integer checks. No claim of external certification or historical priority guarantee.
scientific_limitations: The claim concerns only geometric lines on the characteristic-zero Fermat surface of every integer degree at least three.
It does not claim new line equations, pairwise incidence predicates, previously known line-lattice rank, integral generation or Smith normal form.
Earlier full incidence data make an implicit derivation plausible; priority is not externally certified.
The seven exact test degrees support but cannot prove the all-degree formula; the universal proof is independent Fourier calculation.
title: Integral adjacency spectra and spanning-tree counts for all Fermat-surface line configurations
